body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Dell unveiled its 22-inch crystal LCD wide monitor during CES 2008, which is equipped with 4mm-thick crystal case.
Supporting 1680 x 1050 resolution(WSXGA+), 2000:1 contrast ratio and 2ms response time, it features HD connectivity with DVI/HDMI and 2M webcam with microphone.
